title: From "how did you make Voltane?" to a free "next-gen game console" that runs on any screen
author: MacXou34
selftext:
Two months ago I started working on **Voltane**, just for fun, to see how far I could go using AI for *every* part of a game. 

Voltane is now a complete game coming to all major platforms - we're in beta polishing things & waiting after the big guys to approve our accounts, that seems to be the longest process nowadays \^\^

Some context: I've been a programmer for 20+ years, but I hadn't touched game dev in about a decade. Zero 3D modeling skills, zero animation skills, and definitely no budget to hire an artist for every job a real game needs...

I posted Voltane here and the response was simply awesome. Two of you even bought the founder's pack. Honestly the best €20 I've made in the last ten years 😍

While building it I ended up making a lot of workflows and fixing a lot of the problems you hit when you make a game with AI. And the question I kept getting in the comments and DMs was: **"How did you make this?"**

I ended up packing all of it into one thing. It's called **Cartouche**. I like to think of it as a next-gen console that lives on whatever screen you have:

🎮 **One clean interface for all your games.** Controller or mouse, it doesn't matter.  
📱 **Your PC games on your phone or TV.** Stream them from your own computer.  
🌐 **Browser games, everywhere.** No install, just play.  
🛠️ **Make your own game.** It's the same pipeline I used for Voltane, running on *your own* AI subscription. Describe what you want, iterate, then publish it so anyone can play it in one click.

And all of that is **free**.

Cartouche launches in **alpha in the next few days**. Be the first informed by joining our Discord !  
  
**Cartouche**: [**https://cartouche.gg**](https://cartouche.gg/)  
**Voltane:** [**https://playvoltane.com**](https://playvoltane.com)

**Our discord:** [**https://discord.gg/JXg6Xr97aH**](https://discord.gg/JXg6Xr97aH)

Happy to answer any question !
